title: Leadership Training Affect Physician Career Satisfaction
official: Does Leadership Training Affect Physician Career Satisfaction?
summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the impact of organizational interventions for physician development on wellbeing, and investigate wellbeing and other characteristics of physicians with and without formal leadership roles.

interventions.name: evaluate the impact of organizational interventions for physician development on wellbeing

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: ≥18 years
* Be a current licensed physician practicing at Methodist Health System( MHS )
* Literate in English
* Able and willing to provide consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<18 years of age
* Not a current licensed physician at MHS
* Illiterate in English
* Unable or unwilling to provide consent

sites.f: Clinical Research Institute at Methodist Health System
